faq.a: bettacool is a community app for betta fish enthusiasts. You can post, buy, sell, auction, chat, and share knowledge freely.

faq.q: How do I create an account?
faq.a: Download the bettacool app from the App Store or Play Store, then sign up with your Email, Google, or Apple ID.

faq.q: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq.a: Tap 'Forgot Password' on the Sign In screen. We'll send an OTP to your registered email to reset your password.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Go to Settings in the app and select 'Delete Account'. This will permanently remove all your data.

faq.q: Is the app free to use?
faq.a: Yes, bettacool is completely free to use with all features included.
